Then the entry is refused with MSG-P7-009 naming ruleVersion and no entry is written

  Scenario: AC10 Every decision leaves one entry or nothing stands, and no other service is written (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the extraction decisions of document "DOC-0601" for contract_amount and contract_date are composed
    When the append of the entry for contract_amount fails after its chain position is taken
    Then no entry, no chain position and no outbox row exist for that decision, and the fact is redelivered
    Then the entry, its chain position and its outbox row are written in one transaction
    Then a decision code outside the list in force is refused with MSG-P7-009 naming decisionCode
    Then a repeated decision under the idempotency key "EV-7f3a-0001" adds no entry and counts the repeat
    Then an UPDATE or DELETE on the log is refused, and a correction is a new entry naming the entry it corrects in corrects_entry_id
    Then no document, field, case, legal action, hearing, judgment or treatment is written, and no table of another service is read

  Scenario: AC11 A call without a valid credential is answered 401 on both reads (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller without a valid credential
    When the caller calls GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log
    Then the response is 401 and no entry is returned
    When the caller calls GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log/{entryId} for an entry of "DOC-0601"
    Then the response is 401 and no entry is returned

  Scenario: AC12 A consumed threshold read that fails or does not answer writes no entry (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case parameters contract mock does not answer within 2 s, or answers with an error, for the field threshold
    When the extraction decision of judgment_amount of "DOC-0602" is recorded
    Then no entry is written with an assumed threshold or an assumed parameter version
    Then no entry, no chain position and no outbox row exist for the decision, and the decision is redelivered
